positioning.summary: Software engineer with 15+ years of experience building complex, real-world systems across industrial, spatial computing, and data-heavy domains. Operates at a staff level - designing systems across boundaries (APIs, data flows, user interfaces) and turning ambiguous, high-dimensional problems into usable, high-performance products. Takes end-to-end ownership from product shaping to production systems, contributes to architectural direction, and acts as a technical anchor within teams - unblocking engineers, driving clarity in ambiguous situations, and enabling pragmatic decision-making across product and engineering.
selectedImpact: Led the evolution of a frontend platform for an industrial plant control system, enabling engineers to compose and operate production configurations across deployments; contributed to architecture and company-wide frontend standards.
Bootstrapped a spatial computing platform as the first engineer, designing and implementing a real-time system for time-based 3D data visualization (Babylon.js, React, RxJS).

Drove modernization of a US-based financial platform from a legacy monolith to a Next.js + API architecture, handling complex integrations (e-commerce, learning platforms, SSO) and stabilizing delivery during a critical phase.
